_comment: 16-tile top-down corner-Wang mountain tileset (grey brown rocky mountain over grass). Standard mode emits 16 corner tiles; assemble them in getter order into the 4x4 sheet.
_comment_prompt: 为 Unity 山地地形生成 16-tile autotile 图集，布局以 PixelLab corner-Wang 为准，之后按 corners 数据重配 RuleTile

POST /v2/create-tileset.lower_description: flat green grass with sparse small tufts
POST /v2/create-tileset.transition_description: rocky mountain base blending into grass

TASK.instruction: Poll GET /v2/background-jobs/{background_job_id} from the create step until status is completed or failed, then GET /v2/tilesets/{tileset_id}. Decode each tile's image.base64 and assemble the tiles in the exact order returned by the getter into a 4x4 sheet (row-major, 32px cells) named tileset-4x4.png; do not sort by wang_N, original_position, or corner pattern. Save tileset-4x4.png, a 3x nearest-neighbor preview, and a tiles.json with each tile's id, name, corners, and pattern_4x4. Preserve original pixels; no repainting.
TASK.verify: tileset-4x4.png is 128x128 RGBA with 16 distinct 32px cells filled in getter order; tiles.json lists 16 entries each with NW/NE/SW/SE corners.
